beats.text: A radiation machine killed patients because software replaced a lock.
beats.note: The Therac-25 swapped earlier hardware interlocks for software checks.

beats.name: Therac-25
beats.role: Six documented overdose accidents followed between June 1985 and January 1987. At least three patients died.

beats.text: A fast edit could trick the machine.
beats.note: Slides on the investigation describe an operator changing the mode within about 8 seconds, a race condition in reading input.

beats.context: The worst overdoses were up to 250 times the normal dose, according to Wikipedia.

beats.note: Operators saw messages such as Malfunction 54. Slides on the investigation say they became insensitised to errors.

beats.name: The FDA
beats.role: Issued a shutdown order on 6 February 1987 and required a redesign of the software and the safety interlocks.

beats.text: The software was trusted. The patients paid for it.
